description: This file defines the SearchData class, a data transfer object (DTO) used for encapsulating search-related information about entities within the Fineract project, such as account details, external identifiers, status, and parent relationships.

classes.name: SearchData
classes.description: A data container class representing search entity details including ID, account number, external ID, name, type, parent info, mobile number, status, and sub-entity type.

methods.name: SearchData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all fields of the SearchData class with provided values.
